name: Ambulance
description: The strongest emotional beat. Scenario A's baseline demand, plus a live-operator-triggered emergency green-wave corridor for an ambulance entering at W_entry, bound beyond J3.

live_action.note: This is deliberately NOT a scripted SUMO route-file event. The real Phase 3 green-wave corridor system (ml/emergency/green_wave.py, simulation/sumo_live_bridge.py) drives capture/pre-emption/restore end-to-end from this live API call, exactly as it would for a genuine dispatch — reusing the same code path already live-verified against real TraCI in Phase 3, not a demo-only shortcut. origin/destination are the real, sourced W_entry and E_exit coordinates from shared/corridor_topology.py (never a fabricated pair). The presenter triggers this call ~120s into the Scenario A run so the beat lands at the same point in the corridor's state every rehearsal.
